concerns.text: FR-007 is internally ambiguous: 'Simulations must use MARTINI force field or reduced system size to meet runtime limits.' The disjunction leaves it undetermined which path is required, and the Assumptions section commits only to MARTINI ('The MARTINI force field provides sufficient accuracy...'). Pick one (or specify the decision rule) so FR-007 and the Assumptions section state the same requirement.

FR IDs jump FR-001 → FR-004 → FR-007 → FR-008. No cross-references in the spec point to FR-002/003/005/006, so nothing is broken, but the gaps suggest deleted requirements; either renumber contiguously or confirm the omissions are intentional so future cross-references don't resolve to non-existent IDs.
Terminology drift: Section 1 and US1 say 'simple liquids', SC-001 says 'all solvents'. These denote the same set (water, ethanol, acetone) — use one term consistently.
